'''Xavier "Xavi" Cardelús García''' (born 15 May 1998) is an Andorran [[Motorcycle racing|motorcycle racer]] competing in the [[2026 Supersport World Championship]] for the Cerba Yamaha Racing Team. He is son of the former motorcycle racer Xavier Cardelús Maestre.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.elperiodic.ad/noticia/58586/vuite-i-dese-lloc-de-cardelus-al-circuit-de-catalunya|title=Vuitè i desè lloc de Cardelús al circuit de Catalunya|work=elperiodic.ad|publisher=[[El Periòdic d'Andorra]]|date=19 June 2017|access-date=19 July 2020|language=ca}}</ref>

==Career==
===Early career===
Since [[2015 FIM CEV Moto2 European Championship|2015]], Cardelús competes in the FIM CEV Moto2 European Championship.

In [[2017 Supersport World Championship|2017]], Cardelús also competed in the [[Supersport World Championship]] for [[Alex Baldolini|Race Department ATK#25]].

===Moto2 World Championship===
====Reale Avintia Stylobike (2018)====
===== 2018 =====
In {{MGP|2018|Moto2}}, Cardelús made his Grand Prix debut as a wild card for [[Esponsorama Racing|Team Stylobike]].

====Marinelli Snipers Team (2018)====
At the Aragon round, Cardelús joined Marinelli Snipers Team, replacing [[Romano Fenati]].

====Sama Qatar Ángel Nieto Team (2019)====
===== 2019 =====
Cardelús signed to ride for the [[Aspar Team|Ángel Nieto Team]] in the [[2019 Moto2 World Championship]] with British team-mate [[Jake Dixon]],<ref>[https://www.crash.net/motogp/news/905966/1/official-jake-dixon-moto2-aspar Cardelus signs as Dixon's team-mate at Angel Nieto Team] ''Crash.net'', 10 October 2018. Retrieved 11 October 2018</ref> aboard machinery using [[Triumph Daytona 675|765&nbsp;cc Triumph]] controlled engines new to the series,<ref>[https://www.motorsportweek.com/news/id/20118 Triumph era right time for Moto2 switch - Jake Dixon] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190330044406/https://www.motorsportweek.com/news/id/20118 |date=30 March 2019 }} ''Motorsport Week'', 1 October 2018. Retrieved 11 October 2018</ref> and [[KTM]] chassis.<ref>[https://www.motorsportweek.com/news/id/19473 Aspar to return to Moto2 in 2019 ] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190330044303/https://www.motorsportweek.com/news/id/19473 |date=30 March 2019 }} ''Motorsport Week'', 13 August 2018. Retrieved 11 October 2018</ref>

====Fantic Racing (2024)====
Cardelús joined [[Fantic Motor|Fantic Racing]] with [[Arón Canet]] as a teammate.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://warungasep.net/2024/03/08/mario-aji-naik-kelas-inilah-daftar-nama-pembalap-moto2-2024/|title=Mario Aji Naik Kelas, Inilah Daftar Nama Pembalap Moto2 2024|website=Warung Asep|date=8 March 2024|access-date=8 May 2024|language=id}}</ref>
